text_blocks.snippet: Difficulty concentrating and focusing, Memory problems, Confusion, Slowed thinking, and Reduced attention span.

Brain fog can occur in both acute COVID-19 infection and as a long-term symptom known as "long COVID." The exact mechanisms underlying brain fog in COVID-19 are still being investigated, but it may involve inflammation, changes in blood flow to the brain, or damage to neurons.
